title: RECKON: Large-scale Reference-based Efficient Knowledge Evaluation for Large Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on datasets with counterfactual or unconventional information (e.g., the Uncommon dataset from Feverous) to measure the LLM's tendency to rely on its own erroneous internal parametric memory rather than accurately processing provided external references.

Comparing LLM-as-a-judge baseline outputs (without references) against ground-truth human annotations to measure the evaluator model's systematic tendency to incorrectly classify wrong answers as 'correct'.
